title: Pondo ng Klase
setup: Iniwan ni Ma'am Lourdes ang kahon ng ambagan sa mesa niya at lumabas saglit. Bumulong si Pia, ang katabi mo: '₱20 lang, babayaran ko bukas. Walang makakaalam.'
setup_en: Ma'am Lourdes left the donation box on her desk and stepped out for a moment. Pia, your seatmate, whispers: 'Just ₱20, I'll pay you back tomorrow. No one will know.'

success.text: Sinabi ninyo kay Ma'am. Nainis si Pia, pero napansin ka ni Ma'am.
success.text_en: You tell Ma'am. Pia is upset, but Ma'am notices your honesty.

fail.text: Sumbungera si Pia sa'yo. Nasaktan siya.
fail.text_en: Pia snitches on you. She gets hurt.

callback: saw_it -> Ch2 Card 3 (Pia asks for a bigger favor).
